title: DOESN'T CLING TO THE WINDOW!!!
text: DOESN'T CLING TO THE WINDOW!!!. I loved this so called cling but, it wont cling, not even with water :( too bad cause it is SOOOO PRETTY!  I had to tape it up with packing tape and that even has a hard time sticking to the film.
